# Flyeronic

> Flyeronic is a digital marketing agency in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India (GRM Business Park, Super Corridor). We help local businesses, real estate developers, clinics and startups get more leads through SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, website development and marketing automation.
